name: google/gemini-3.8-flash
description: Gemini 3.8 Flash is a Flash-tier reasoning model in Google's Gemini 3 series, released in September 2026 and described by Google as its most intelligent Flash model as of release. Google positions it for long-horizon software engineering, autonomous agents and complex enterprise workflows, with significant gains over 3.7 Flash in coding, agentic tasks and multi-step reasoning in specialized domains. It accepts text, image, video, audio and PDF input with text output, and suits demanding agentic and coding work.
